SYMPTOM: Console: 'Will attempt to recover by breaking constraint UIButton.width == 45 (active)' — row 3 (shift, letters, delete) throws unsatisfiable constraints
CAUSE: Shift button width == 45 and delete button width == shift.widthAnchor set at .required (1000) priority. UIStackView's UISV-fill-equally constraints for the letter buttons conflict when the total row width doesn't evenly accommodate 10 letter buttons + 2 side buttons at fixed 45pt each.
FIX: Set both shift and delete width constraints to `.defaultHigh` (750) priority:
  shiftWidthConstraint.priority = .defaultHigh
  deleteWidthConstraint.priority = .defaultHigh
This lets UIStackView's spacing/fill constraints win when needed while still enforcing the desired width in normal cases.
FILE: WhisnapKeyboard/KeyboardView.swift makeRow3()
PREVENT: Fixed-width constraints inside UIStackView arranged subviews should almost never be .required
